papers.title: CARE-3D: Reinforcement Learning for Evidence Grounded Agentic Reasoning in Situated 3D Scenes
papers.summary: CARE-3D is a reinforcement post-training framework that combines supervised fine-tuning, Group Relative Policy Optimization, counterfactual evidence attribution, and group coverage sampling to improve adaptive grounded 3D reasoning and tool use.

papers.title: Evaluating Memanto on DolphinBench for AI Agents
papers.summary: Memanto, a memory agent using information-theoretic relevance scoring, completes more simulated workplace tasks at lower cost and latency than the strongest reported Mem0 configuration.

papers.title: Look Back: Reinforcement Learning with Counterfactual World Models
papers.summary: Counterfactual world models that predict alternative outcomes from observed trajectories under the same environmental randomness enable a policy gradient estimator using counterfactual returns as baselines, improving policy learning when environmental dynamics are harder to predict than action effects.

papers.title: Single-Database Rewards Are Hackable: Counterfactual Execution for Trustworthy Text-to-SQL RL
papers.summary: A counterfactual-database reward for reinforcement learning text-to-SQL agents reduces full payment to buggy queries and reward hacks, though training with its mean form did not improve in-domain accuracy in a controlled GRPO comparison.
